name: @w6w-apps/cloze
description: Cloze relationship CRM: people, companies, projects, timeline notes and to-dos, and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Cloze is a relationship-management CRM that builds a timeline of every email, call and meeting around the people, companies and projects (deals) you work with. This app drives the Cloze API from a workflow.

Search, read, create, update and delete people, companies and projects; stream changes with the cursored feeds; read a record's timeline and the messages on it; add to-dos, notes and communication records to a timeline; read your stages, segments, steps, custom fields, tags and team; and subscribe webhooks to record changes.

It authenticates with a Cloze API key sent as a bearer token. The analytics endpoints, team-member updates, form submission and CardDAV are not part of this app.
